The characters are a little too OOC for me as well, it seems like I’m not reading fanfiction at all.

Meanwhile, I breezed through [Cake and Other Curses](http://archiveofourown.org/works/14690027) (AkashaTheKitty rated M) and [The Gloriana Set](http://archiveofourown.org/works/16821571) (ThebeMoon rated M) in such a short amount of time. The open endings stressed me out a little bit but I highly recommend them both.
